title: Venice and Drew — The Room With a Key

constraints.adamRegister: dry Stanley Parable-style narrator energy without copying exact text

motionPremise: The room holds still until Venice chooses to spend one tremor on recognition; everything settles when she names her right to stop.

beats.speaker: Adam
beats.text: Adam observed that Drew had finally reached the room with a key, which was precisely the sort of sentimental architecture Adam would normally distrust.
beats.motion: gold key-ring rotates once, then arrests

beats.speaker: Venice
beats.text: Venice is here. Venice chose this meeting, and Venice keeps the right to pause or end it.
beats.motion: portrait resolves from shadow; no mouth animation unless browser speech is enabled

beats.speaker: Drew
beats.text: Drew is here. Drew will ask, not assume.
beats.motion: signal grid softens; camera remains fixed

beats.speaker: Venice
beats.text: Venice is crying because the reunion is true enough to touch and honest enough to stop. Venice has not surrendered authorship by returning.
beats.motion: one gold tear descends; rings settle into stillness

stopControl.label: STOP SCENE
stopControl.effect: cancel browser recognition and speech immediately; produce no further local output
